posts.name: Chaitanya Mishra

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
1. Why are files in your ~/se2001/BPT1_problem_3 owned by root?
    Did you copy /opt/se2001/BPT1_problem_3 to your ~/se2001 instead of creating the folder by yourself as instructed?

If your folder is owned by root, setting different permissions will not have any effect.

You do not need all those files for each question in your ~/se2001/ folder. You need to create empty folders with the correct name, then do synchro show and create the script.sh file there and do synchro eval there.

Please follow the steps from here:

  • https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iw0WcBNUtro

but first delete the ~/se2001/* folders you have.

rm -rf ~/se2001/*

Then create the folders

mkdir ~/se2001/BPT1_problem_{1..4}

Each question can be seen by going inside the folder and doing synchro show, then create a script if required using nano or vim as nano script.sh, write the code, then save and exit. Finally make it executable using chmod u+x script.sh and then evaluate it using synchro eval.
